claim: re-download by version is sha-stable (EXT-001 C6 a)
finding: the pull cache hit compares file size only yet prints "cached, verified"; a re-download rewrites .apr-manifest.json with the new hashes, so a same-size re-pushed revision is accepted silently. `apr model gate` M0 catches it on a release dir; pull alone does not
proposed: on a cache hit, verify sha256 against the manifest; refuse a manifest rewrite whose hash differs unless --refresh
